name: Barbarian
subtitle: A fierce warrior of primitive background who can enter a battle rage

coreTraits.label: Skill Proficiencies
coreTraits.value: Choose 2: Animal Handling, Athletics, Intimidation, Nature, Perception, or Survival
coreTraits.value_tr: 2 seçin: Hayvan Bakımı, Atletizm, Gözdağı, Doğa, Algı veya Hayatta Kalma

coreTraits.label: Armor Training
coreTraits.value: Light and Medium armor and Shields
coreTraits.value_tr: Hafif ve Orta Zırh ve Kalkanlar

coreTraits.label: Starting Equipment
coreTraits.value: Choose A or B: (A) Greataxe, 4 Handaxes, Explorer's Pack, and 15 GP; or (B) 75 GP
coreTraits.value_tr: A veya B seçin: (A) Büyük Balta, 4 El Baltası, Kaşif Çantası ve 15 AP; veya (B) 75 AP

features.title: Rage
features.body:
You can imbue yourself with a primal power called Rage as a Bonus Action if you aren't wearing Heavy armor.


Damage Resistance. You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.


Rage Damage. When you make an attack using Strength and deal damage, you gain a bonus shown in the Rage Damage column.


Strength Advantage. You have Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.


No Concentration or Spells. You can't maintain Concentration or cast spells.


Duration. The Rage lasts until the end of your next turn. Extend it each round by attacking an enemy, forcing a saving throw, or taking a Bonus Action to extend. Max 10 minutes.

features.title: Unarmored Defense
features.body: While you aren't wearing any armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Constitution modifiers. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

features.title: Weapon Mastery
features.body: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of Simple or Martial Melee weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change one of those weapon choices.

features.title: Danger Sense
features.body: You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

features.title: Reckless Attack
features.body: When you make your first attack roll on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly. Doing so gives you Advantage on Strength attack rolls until the start of your next turn, but attack rolls against you also have Advantage.

features.title: Primal Knowledge
features.body: You gain proficiency in another skill from the Barbarian list. While Raging, you can make Strength checks for Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival.

features.title: Barbarian Subclass
features.body: You gain a Barbarian subclass of your choice. Choose your path below:

features.title: Ability Score Improvement
features.body: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at levels 8, 12, and 16.

features.title: Extra Attack
features.body: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.title: Fast Movement
features.body: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

features.title: Subclass Feature
features.body: You gain a new feature from your chosen subclass.

features.title: Feral Instinct
features.body: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

features.title: Instinctive Pounce
features.body: As part of the Bonus Action you take to enter your Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.

features.title: Ability Score Improvement
features.body: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.title: Brutal Strike
features.body:
If you use Reckless Attack, you can forgo Advantage on one Strength-based attack roll. If it hits, the target takes an extra 1d10 damage and you can apply one Brutal Strike effect:


Forceful Blow. Push the target 15 feet away. You can then move up to half your Speed toward them without provoking Opportunity Attacks.


Hamstring Blow. The target's Speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn.

features.title: Subclass Feature
features.body: You gain a new feature from your chosen subclass.

features.title: Relentless Rage
features.body: If you drop to 0 HP while Raging and don't die outright, make a DC 10 Constitution save. On success, your HP becomes twice your Barbarian level. Each subsequent use increases the DC by 5, resetting on a Short or Long Rest.

features.title: Ability Score Improvement
features.body: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.title: Improved Brutal Strike
features.body:
Staggering Blow. The target has Disadvantage on its next saving throw and can't make Opportunity Attacks until your next turn.


Sundering Blow. The next attack roll against the target before your next turn gains a +5 bonus.

features.title: Subclass Feature
features.body: You gain a new feature from your chosen subclass.

features.title: Persistent Rage
features.body: When you roll Initiative, you can regain all expended uses of Rage (once per Long Rest). Your Rage now lasts 10 minutes without extension actions, ending only if you are Unconscious or don Heavy armor.

features.title: Ability Score Improvement
features.body: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.title: Improved Brutal Strike
features.body: The extra damage of your Brutal Strike increases to 2d10. You can also apply two different Brutal Strike effects whenever you use this feature.

features.title: Indomitable Might
features.body: If your total for a Strength check or Strength saving throw is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.

features.title: Epic Boon
features.body: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Irresistible Offense is recommended.

features.title: Primal Champion
features.body: You embody primal power. Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.
